title: Vintage Le Creuset Enamel Kettle – Soft Green / Lime Gradient – 1.5L
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset kettle in a lovely soft green shade with a brighter lime gradient at the base, a very cheerful and uncommon color combination. This elegant rounded shape gives it a charming retro look while remaining timeless and practical.
The kettle has a black speckled enamel interior, original black handle and whistle, and retains its original bottom marking indicating a 1.5L capacity. A wonderful decorative and usable piece for a vintage kitchen or Le Creuset collection.
Overall in very good vintage condition with light signs of age and use consistent with vintage cookware. The enamel remains glossy and presents beautifully. Please look carefully at all pictures as they are part of the description.
Approximate dimensions:
Height with handle down: around 17 cm
Width including spout: around 24 cm
Capacity: 1.5L
A beautiful and increasingly hard to find vintage Le Creuset piece, perfect for collectors or lovers of vintage French kitchenware.
